run_adsorb_atoms: run adsorb_atoms to relax an adslab system and compute adsorption energy with a given calculator
compute_adsorption_energy_hybrid: compute hybrid adsorption energy by combining ML-relaxed adslab energy with DFT slab reference energy
compute_adsorption_energy_full: compute full adsorption energy by relaxing both the adslab and bare surface with an ML calculator
relax_adslab_and_save: relax an adslab atoms object and save the relaxed structure as JSON-encoded output
review_adsorb_atoms: review the adsorb_atoms function to understand how it computes direct, hybrid, and full adsorption energies
